independent_method.air: Independent reviewer computes check-polynomial RHS with remap[0,2,1,3] and ((3z)^(2^18)-1); generated AIR interpreter is separately inspected against pinned adapter.rs and compared through its returned total. Reviewer does not independently execute generated AIR LHS.
independent_method.deep: Each of 163 registers contributes separately with one mix power per register; common symbolic denominators are cached only for inversion, not by forming combo-U coefficient batches.
independent_method.field: Ordinary integer convolution reduced by X^4+11 over modulus 2013265921; inverses exponentiated and product-checked.
independent_method.fold: Direct inverse DFT16 with ROU_REV[4] and 1/16 normalization; independently reviewed upstream reverse-butterfly plus bit_reverse equivalence.
independent_method.montgomery: Every receipt field word converted by (2^32)^-1 modulo p. Root literals and AIR constants interpreted in ordinary form.
independent_method.terminal: Coordinate-major 64 coefficients, Horner evaluation at ROU_FWD[8]^position.

preliminary_order_mismatch: review/comparison-order-review.json retains the failed initial numerical-order-versus-register-order comparison and correction to named identities.

repaired_report_validation_defect.correction: Require strict integer query identities 0..49 and integer combo 0..4 or exact string check; also check canonical field arrays and strict query indices on both reports.
repaired_report_validation_defect.issue: Python bool/int key equality accepted false/true in place of denominator query/combo identities 0/1.
repaired_report_validation_defect.scope: Report-validation defect; no accepted native malformed receipt or W1 forgery was demonstrated.

review_scope: Independent arithmetic implementation, pinned upstream source reading, report validation controls and static workflow review; not independent institution or cryptographic certification.
source_review_findings: U coefficients use contiguous extension quadruples; FRI leaf rows and terminal coefficients use coordinate-major layouts.
Tap register iterator advances by skip; batching mix powers advance 163 times, followed by 16 check powers.
AndCond applies field arithmetic condition*inner.total*chain.multiplier and preserves the independent mix-register bank.
The SDK defines inverse(0)=0; this audit instead refuses zero DEEP divisors. This difference is explicit and does not affect the fixed receipt, whose 300 denominators are nonzero.
No arithmetic/ordering defect was found in the reviewed replay.

observations: Exact head or prospective merge source checked before and after execution.
Named tests must be registered, started and successful; skipped/expected-failure/missing completion refused.
Actual replay and independent reviewer execute even if control stage failed; final completion requires all stages successful.
Report and review digests must match freshly captured files.
